idea-plugin.name: gRPC Error Status Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter warning icon on a streamObserver.onError(rawException) call where the argument isn't converted through gRPC's own Status type -- gRPC's own StreamObserver.onError javadoc states the parameter "should be a StatusException or StatusRuntimeException, and callers should generally convert from a Status via Status.asException() or Status.asRuntimeException()". Passing a raw exception means its real type/message never reaches the client -- gRPC only transmits the Status code and description across the wire, not the original exception.

100% static text/PSI analysis -- matches the receiver variable name and the argument's converted-Status signals by simple text, so it works whether the real gRPC jar is on the classpath or not. Java and Kotlin.

Stated honestly: v0.1 doesn't resolve the receiver's real type -- a variable named observer that isn't actually a StreamObserver is a possible (rare) false positive, and a real StreamObserver with an unusual variable name isn't covered.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
